nodes.statement: Fix smooth projective, rational cohomology, and cycle-class semantics.
Prove equivalence with rational generation by subvariety classes.
Select a restricted class beyond dimension three and construct cycles for every allowed Hodge class.

forbidden_shortcuts: Assume algebraicity of inverse Lefschetz correspondences without naming it.
Replace rational projective Hodge by the false integral or unrestricted compact-Kahler analogue.
Treat Hodge-locus algebraicity as construction of a cycle on every fibre.
